temporal_controls: Open Temporal Controls for the current selection. Choose a control system, position and orientation spaces, a label, and a color. Each object gets a matching control that carries its animation keys and drives it through the chosen spaces.
temporal_controls_bake: Extract the selected Temporal Controls' keyframes onto their original objects and remove the controls.
If nothing is selected, bakes every Temporal Control in the scene.
temporal_controls_revert: Remove the selected Temporal Controls and restore their original objects' animation and connections.
If nothing is selected, reverts every Temporal Control in the scene.
